q: 这件衣服___那件贵。
zh: 这件衣服比那件贵。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu bǐ nà jiàn guì
en: This shirt is more expensive than that one.
why: 比 goes between A and the adjective to say 'more than'. 没有 would say 'not as expensive as', 跟 needs 一样, and 最 needs a group of three or more.

q: 篮球比足球___好玩。
zh: 篮球比足球好玩。
py: lán qiú bǐ zú qiú hǎo wán
en: Basketball is more fun than football.
why: In a 比 sentence the adjective stays bare. 很, 非常 and 太 cannot stand in front of it; only 更 or 还 may, and those are not offered here.

q: 这家店的鞋已经很便宜了，那家比这家___便宜。
zh: 这家店的鞋已经很便宜了，那家比这家更便宜。
py: zhè jiā diàn de xié yǐ jīng hěn pián yi le nà jiā bǐ zhè jiā gèng pián yi
en: The shoes at this shop are already cheap, and that shop is even cheaper than this one.
why: 'Even cheaper than something already cheap' is 比 + 更. 很, 有点儿 and 比较 cannot be put before the adjective of a 比 sentence.

q: 虽然这个牌子的手机很贵，但是那个牌子的比这个牌子的___贵。
zh: 虽然这个牌子的手机很贵，但是那个牌子的比这个牌子的还贵。
py: suī rán zhè ge pái zi de shǒu jī hěn guì dàn shì nà ge pái zi de bǐ zhè ge pái zi de hái guì
en: Although this brand of phone is expensive, that brand's is even more expensive than this one's.
why: The brand is already dear, so 'even more' needs 还 (or 更) before 贵. 很, 非常 and 太 are never allowed before the adjective after 比.

q: 这双鞋比那双便宜___。
zh: 这双鞋比那双便宜一点儿。
py: zhè shuāng xié bǐ nà shuāng pián yi yī diǎn r
en: These shoes are a little cheaper than those.
why: A small difference goes after the adjective: 便宜一点儿. 有点儿, 很 and 非常 stand before an adjective and cannot be used in or after a 比 sentence like this.

q: 我比哥哥___两岁。
zh: 我比哥哥小两岁。
py: wǒ bǐ gē ge xiǎo liǎng suì
en: I'm two years younger than my older brother.
why: The number goes after the adjective: 小两岁. An older brother means I am younger, so 小 fits; 大 would make me older and 高 is about height.

q: 这台电脑比那台便宜___，这台只要两千，那台要五千。
zh: 这台电脑比那台便宜得多，这台只要两千，那台要五千。
py: zhè tái diàn nǎo bǐ nà tái pián yi de duō zhè tái zhǐ yào liǎng qiān nà tái yào wǔ qiān
en: This computer is much cheaper than that one: this one costs only two thousand and that one five thousand.
why: A big gap (two thousand against five thousand) is 得多 after the adjective. 一点儿 means only slightly, and 有点儿 and 很 do not belong after 便宜 in a 比 sentence.

q: 今天的西瓜比昨天的贵___，一斤只贵一毛钱。
zh: 今天的西瓜比昨天的贵一点儿，一斤只贵一毛钱。
py: jīn tiān de xī guā bǐ zuó tiān de guì yī diǎn r yī jīn zhǐ guì yī máo qián
en: Today's watermelon is a little pricier than yesterday's, only one mao more per jin.
why: The difference is tiny (one mao), so 一点儿. 得多, 多了 and 很多 all say the gap is big, which contradicts 只贵一毛钱.

q: 他篮球打得比我好___，我完全比不上他。
zh: 他篮球打得比我好得多，我完全比不上他。
py: tā lán qiú dǎ de bǐ wǒ hǎo de duō wǒ wán quán bǐ bu shàng tā
en: He plays basketball much better than I do; I can't compare with him at all.
why: 'Can't compare at all' needs a big difference: 好得多 after the adjective. 一点儿 and 一些 mean only slightly better, and 点儿 alone is not a complete amount word.

q: 我的球拍___他的好。
zh: 我的球拍没有他的好。
py: wǒ de qiú pāi méi yǒu tā de hǎo
en: My racket is not as good as his.
why: 'Not as good as' is A 没有 B + adjective. 不 cannot link two nouns like this, 比 would say mine is better, and 跟 needs 一样.

q: 今天的菜市场没有周末___热闹。
zh: 今天的菜市场没有周末那么热闹。
py: jīn tiān de cài shì chǎng méi yǒu zhōu mò nà me rè nao
en: The market today is not as lively as at the weekend.
why: After 没有 + B only 这么 or 那么 may precede the adjective. 很 cannot be added, and 得多 and 一点儿 cannot follow it in a 没有 sentence.

q: 我游泳游得___他快。
zh: 我游泳游得没有他快。
py: wǒ yóu yǒng yóu de méi yǒu tā kuài
en: I don't swim as fast as he does.
why: 'Not as fast as' is 没有 + B + adjective, even after verb + 得. 不 and 很 cannot take the place of 没有, and 比 would claim I am faster, against the English.

q: 这家网店的东西___别家那么便宜，所以我没买。
zh: 这家网店的东西没有别家那么便宜，所以我没买。
py: zhè jiā wǎng diàn de dōng xi méi yǒu bié jiā nà me pián yi suǒ yǐ wǒ méi mǎi
en: The things at this online shop aren't as cheap as at other shops, so I didn't buy any.
why: 那么 before the adjective belongs to the 没有 pattern. 比 and 更 cannot be used with 那么, and 不比 would mean 'no cheaper than', which does not give a reason for not buying.

q: 这件衣服___那件好看。
zh: 这件衣服没有那件好看。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu méi yǒu nà jiàn hǎo kàn
en: This piece of clothing is not as nice as that one.
why: 'Not as nice as' is A 没有 B + adjective. 比 would say this one is nicer, 最 needs a group, and 一样 cannot sit between the nouns without 跟.

q: 你说这家店贵，其实它___别家贵，价钱都差不多。
zh: 你说这家店贵，其实它不比别家贵，价钱都差不多。
py: nǐ shuō zhè jiā diàn guì qí shí tā bù bǐ bié jiā guì jià qián dōu chà bu duō
en: You say this shop is expensive, but it is actually no more expensive than the others; the prices are about the same.
why: 不比 means 'not more than', so equal prices are fine and it corrects what someone said. 没有 means clearly cheaper, 比 means dearer, and 不如 cannot be followed by the bad adjective 贵.

q: 买书___借书省钱，图书馆的书不要钱。
zh: 买书不如借书省钱，图书馆的书不要钱。
py: mǎi shū bù rú jiè shū shěng qián tú shū guǎn de shū bù yào qián
en: Buying books is not as money-saving as borrowing them; library books are free.
why: A 不如 B + adjective says A is not as good as B in that way. 不 alone cannot link the two actions, and 比 or 更 would say buying saves more, which is the opposite.

q: 我的球技___他，所以他当队长。
zh: 我的球技不如他，所以他当队长。
py: wǒ de qiú jì bù rú tā suǒ yǐ tā dāng duì zhǎng
en: My skill isn't as good as his, so he is the captain.
why: A 不如 B works without an adjective: 'A is not as good as B'. 不 and 没 cannot stand directly in front of 他 here, and 比 would say I am better, against the reason given.

q: 我的球鞋___你的一样。
zh: 我的球鞋跟你的一样。
py: wǒ de qiú xié gēn nǐ de yī yàng
en: My sneakers are the same as yours.
why: 'The same as' is 跟/和 + B + 一样. 比 always means a difference, 没有 means less, and 最 is for the top of a group.

q: 这两个包的价钱___，都是八十块。
zh: 这两个包的价钱一样，都是八十块。
py: zhè liǎng ge bāo de jià qián yī yàng dōu shì bā shí kuài
en: The two bags cost the same: eighty yuan each.
why: Both being eighty yuan makes them the same, so 一样. 不一样 would contradict 都是八十块, and 没有 cannot end the clause without an adjective.

q: 他打球打得跟他哥哥___好。
zh: 他打球打得跟他哥哥一样好。
py: tā dǎ qiú dǎ de gēn tā gē ge yī yàng hǎo
en: He plays ball as well as his older brother does.
why: 跟 + B + 一样 + adjective says 'as ... as'. 比 cannot follow 跟, 很 cannot replace 一样, and 没有 cannot follow 跟.

q: 网上的价格___商店里的一样，所以我在网上买，不用出门。
zh: 网上的价格跟商店里的一样，所以我在网上买，不用出门。
py: wǎng shàng de jià gé gēn shāng diàn lǐ de yī yàng suǒ yǐ wǒ zài wǎng shàng mǎi bù yòng chū mén
en: Online prices are the same as in the shops, so I buy online and don't need to go out.
why: 一样 needs 跟 or 和 in front of the thing compared. 比, 更 and 最 cannot combine with 一样 and would describe a difference.

q: 这家店的运动服看起来跟那家的一样，可是价格___，这家贵多了。
zh: 这家店的运动服看起来跟那家的一样，可是价格不一样，这家贵多了。
py: zhè jiā diàn de yùn dòng fú kàn qǐ lái gēn nà jiā de yī yàng kě shì jià gé bù yī yàng zhè jiā guì duō le
en: The sports clothes in this shop look the same as that shop's, but the prices are different: this one is much more expensive.
why: 可是 signals a contrast, and 贵多了 shows the prices differ, so 不一样. 一样 would repeat the first clause, and 没有 cannot end the clause alone.

q: 我们班他篮球打得___好。
zh: 我们班他篮球打得最好。
py: wǒ men bān tā lán qiú dǎ de zuì hǎo
en: In our class he plays basketball best.
why: The group 我们班 is named first and 最 sits right before the adjective for 'the best'. 更 needs something already mentioned, 很 only says 'very', and 比 needs a B.

q: 三种运动里，我___喜欢游泳。
zh: 三种运动里，我最喜欢游泳。
py: sān zhǒng yùn dòng lǐ wǒ zuì xǐ huan yóu yǒng
en: Of the three sports, I like swimming best.
why: 'Best of a group of three' is 最 before 喜欢. 比 needs a B, 很 does not pick one out of three, and 太 would mean 'too much'.

q: 这个背包已经很便宜了，那个___便宜，只要三十块。
zh: 这个背包已经很便宜了，那个更便宜，只要三十块。
py: zhè ge bēi bāo yǐ jīng hěn pián yi le nà ge gèng pián yi zhǐ yào sān shí kuài
en: This bag is already cheap, and that one is even cheaper: only thirty yuan.
why: 更 means 'even more' than something just mentioned. 最 would crown it the cheapest of all, 比较 means 'fairly', and 很 gives no extra step beyond the first bag.

q: 这个周末天气___好，我们去打球吧。
zh: 这个周末天气比较好，我们去打球吧。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò tiān qì bǐ jiào hǎo wǒ men qù dǎ qiú ba
en: The weather this weekend is fairly good, so let's go play ball.
why: No second item is named, so 比较 ('fairly') goes before 好. 比 would need a B, and 更 and 最 mean 'even more' and 'most'.

q: 这三双鞋里红色的___好看，另外两双都没有它好看。
zh: 这三双鞋里红色的最好看，另外两双都没有它好看。
py: zhè sān shuāng xié lǐ hóng sè de zuì hǎo kàn lìng wài liǎng shuāng dōu méi yǒu tā hǎo kàn
en: Of these three pairs, the red ones are the nicest; the other two aren't as nice.
why: The group 这三双鞋里 comes first and 最 sits before the adjective. 比 needs a B, 没有 would say the red pair is the one that is not as nice, and 一样 cannot stand before 好看.

q: 他跑___比我快。
zh: 他跑得比我快。
py: tā pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài
en: He runs faster than I do.
why: How an action is done needs 得 after the verb, also when 比 comes in between. 的 and 地 are other particles, and 了 does not link a verb to its manner.

q: 他踢足球___得比我好。
zh: 他踢足球踢得比我好。
py: tā tī zú qiú tī de bǐ wǒ hǎo
en: He plays football better than I do.
why: With an object, the verb is repeated before 得: 踢足球踢得. Leaving out the second verb gives 踢足球得, which is not possible, and 打 or 做 do not go with 足球 here.

q: 弟弟每天都练习，现在他游泳游___比我快多了。
zh: 弟弟每天都练习，现在他游泳游得比我快多了。
py: dì di měi tiān dōu liàn xí xiàn zài tā yóu yǒng yóu de bǐ wǒ kuài duō le
en: My younger brother practises every day, and now he swims much faster than I do.
why: Verb + 得 + 比我 + adjective is the pattern for comparing an action. 了, 着 and 的 cannot join the verb 游 to 比我快, and the amount 多了 still comes last.

q: 秋天到了，天气___冷了。
zh: 秋天到了，天气越来越冷了。
py: qiū tiān dào le tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le
en: Autumn has come and the weather is getting colder and colder.
why: 'More and more' is the whole pattern 越来越 before the adjective, with 了 at the end. 越来 is incomplete, and 很 or 有点儿 describe a state rather than a change.

q: 我越来越___跑步了。
zh: 我越来越喜欢跑步了。
py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan pǎo bù le
en: I like running more and more.
why: 越来越 already carries the degree, so 喜欢 follows it directly. 很, 更 and 太 cannot be stacked behind 越来越.

q: 网上购物的人___多了。
zh: 网上购物的人越来越多了。
py: wǎng shàng gòu wù de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
en: More and more people shop online.
why: The idea 'more and more' is 越来越 right before 多, usually with 了. 最 and 比 need a group or a B, and 很多了 says nothing about growth.

q: 他练了半年以后，投篮投得___准了。
zh: 他练了半年以后，投篮投得越来越准了。
py: tā liàn le bàn nián yǐ hòu tóu lán tóu de yuè lái yuè zhǔn le
en: After half a year of practice, his shooting has become more and more accurate.
why: With an action verb 越来越 goes after 得 and directly before the adjective. Adding 更 or 很, or putting 很 in front, breaks the pattern.

q: 弟弟比我___高。
zh: 弟弟比我高。
py: dì di bǐ wǒ gāo
en: My younger brother is taller than me.
why: The adjective after 比 is bare. 很, 非常 and 太 may not stand before it, so nothing is inserted: 比我高.

zh: 打球比看球有意思。
py: dǎ qiú bǐ kàn qiú yǒu yì si
en: Playing ball is more fun than watching it.
why: A 比 B + adjective: the 比 phrase sits before the adjective, not after it as in English 'than'.

zh: 他的球拍比我的更好。
py: tā de qiú pāi bǐ wǒ de gèng hǎo
en: His racket is even better than mine.
why: 更 sits right before the adjective, after the 比 phrase. 比 B must come before it, not at the end.

zh: 商场里的东西比网上的更贵。
py: shāng chǎng lǐ de dōng xi bǐ wǎng shàng de gèng guì
en: Things in the mall are even more expensive than those online.
why: The 比 phrase comes right after the subject and 更 right before 贵; 贵 stays last.

zh: 姐姐比我大两岁。
py: jiě jie bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì
en: My older sister is two years older than me.
why: The size of the age gap goes after the adjective: 大两岁, never 两岁大.

zh: 这条裤子比那条便宜二十块。
py: zhè tiáo kù zi bǐ nà tiáo pián yi èr shí kuài
en: These trousers are twenty yuan cheaper than that pair.
why: The exact difference follows the adjective: 便宜二十块. Putting it before 便宜 is the English order and is wrong.

zh: 今年的票价比去年贵得多。
py: jīn nián de piào jià bǐ qù nián guì de duō
en: This year's ticket price is much higher than last year's.
why: 比 去年 comes before the adjective, and 得多 for 'much' attaches after the adjective at the end.

zh: 在网上买比在商店买便宜一些。
py: zài wǎng shàng mǎi bǐ zài shāng diàn mǎi pián yi yī xiē
en: Buying online is a bit cheaper than buying in a shop.
why: The verb phrases are compared with 比, and the small difference 一些 goes after 便宜.

zh: 我没有哥哥高。
py: wǒ méi yǒu gē ge gāo
en: I'm not as tall as my older brother.
why: 'Not as tall as' is A 没有 B + adjective; the adjective stays last and carries no 很.

zh: 今天的比赛没有昨天的那么精彩。
py: jīn tiān de bǐ sài méi yǒu zuó tiān de nà me jīng cǎi
en: Today's match is not as exciting as yesterday's.
why: 那么 comes between B and the adjective in the 没有 pattern; it cannot go before 没有.

zh: 跑步没有游泳那么累。
py: pǎo bù méi yǒu yóu yǒng nà me lèi
en: Running is not as tiring as swimming.
why: A 没有 B 那么 adjective: 那么 is placed right before 累, after B.

zh: 这个牌子不比那个牌子贵。
py: zhè ge pái zi bù bǐ nà ge pái zi guì
en: This brand is no more expensive than that one.
why: 不 goes in front of 比, not in front of the adjective: 不比 B 贵. 比 B 不贵 is wrong.

zh: 网上买东西不如在店里买放心。
py: wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xi bù rú zài diàn lǐ mǎi fàng xīn
en: Buying online isn't as reassuring as buying in a shop.
why: A 不如 B + adjective takes a good quality such as 放心; 不如 B stands before the adjective.

zh: 我跟你一样高。
py: wǒ gēn nǐ yī yàng gāo
en: I'm as tall as you.
why: 跟 + B + 一样 + adjective. 一样 follows B and the bare adjective comes last, with no 很.

zh: 我的球拍和你的一样。
py: wǒ de qiú pāi hé nǐ de yī yàng
en: My racket is the same as yours.
why: 和 B 一样 comes after the subject; 一样 is the last word when no adjective is added.

zh: 网上的价格跟商店里的一样便宜。
py: wǎng shàng de jià gé gēn shāng diàn lǐ de yī yàng pián yi
en: Online prices are as cheap as those in shops.
why: 跟 B 一样 sits before the adjective 便宜; the adjective stays bare.

zh: 我最喜欢踢足球。
py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan tī zú qiú
en: I like playing football best.
why: 最 goes directly before 喜欢, not after the verb or at the end.

zh: 小王是我们队最高的。
py: xiǎo wáng shì wǒ men duì zuì gāo de
en: Xiao Wang is the tallest on our team.
why: The group 我们队 comes before 最, unlike English 'tallest in our team'.

zh: 这个篮球比较贵，但是质量很好。
py: zhè ge lán qiú bǐ jiào guì dàn shì zhì liàng hěn hǎo
en: This basketball is fairly expensive, but the quality is very good.
why: 比较 means 'fairly' and sits right before 贵, with no B named.

zh: 他比我跑得快。
py: tā bǐ wǒ pǎo de kuài
en: He runs faster than I do.
why: 比我 may stand before the verb or right after 得, and 得 stays attached to the verb. The adjective is last.

zh: 妹妹游泳游得比我好。
py: mèi mei yóu yǒng yóu de bǐ wǒ hǎo
en: My younger sister swims better than I do.
why: With an object the verb repeats; 比我 may sit before the first verb, before the second verb or after 得, but the adjective stays last.

zh: 姐姐跑得比我快多了。
py: jiě jie pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài duō le
en: My older sister runs much faster than I do.
why: The amount 多了 goes at the very end after the adjective; 比我 may come before 跑得 or after it.

zh: 弟弟吃得比我多。
py: dì di chī de bǐ wǒ duō
en: My younger brother eats more than I do.
why: 得 stays with the verb, 比我 sits before the verb or after 得, and 多 closes the sentence.

zh: 天气越来越热了。
py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè le
en: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.
why: 越来越 sits right before the adjective, with 了 at the end to mark the change.

zh: 我越来越喜欢骑自行车了。
py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan qí zì xíng chē le
en: I like cycling more and more.
why: 越来越 goes between the subject and 喜欢, with no 很 or 更.

zh: 他打网球打得越来越好了。
py: tā dǎ wǎng qiú dǎ de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
en: He plays tennis better and better.
why: With an action verb 越来越 follows 得 and comes directly before the adjective.

src: 这件五十块，那件八十块。
src_py: zhè jiàn wǔ shí kuài nà jiàn bā shí kuài
task: Say that one is more expensive than this one, using 比.
zh: 那件比这件贵。
py: nà jiàn bǐ zhè jiàn guì
en: That one is more expensive than this one.
why: The 比 phrase goes before the adjective, and 贵 stays bare, with no 很.

src: 我们的球队很强，他们的球队更强。
src_py: wǒ men de qiú duì hěn qiáng tā men de qiú duì gèng qiáng
task: Join the two ideas into one sentence with 比 and 更.
zh: 他们的球队比我们的更强。
py: tā men de qiú duì bǐ wǒ men de gèng qiáng
en: Their team is even stronger than ours.
why: 更 stays before the adjective after the 比 phrase. 很 cannot be kept.

src: 我比他矮。
src_py: wǒ bǐ tā ǎi
task: Say 'I'm not as tall as he is' with 没有.
zh: 我没有他高。
py: wǒ méi yǒu tā gāo
en: I'm not as tall as he is.
why: 'Not as tall as' is A 没有 B + the big-end adjective 高, not 比 with 不.

src: 在网上买比在商店买便宜。
src_py: zài wǎng shàng mǎi bǐ zài shāng diàn mǎi pián yi
task: Say buying in a shop is not as cheap as buying online, using 没有.
zh: 在商店买没有在网上买便宜。
py: zài shāng diàn mǎi méi yǒu zài wǎng shàng mǎi pián yi
en: Buying in a shop is not as cheap as buying online.
why: The two items swap places: the shop is A and online is B, joined by 没有 with the adjective last.

src: 这个二十块，那个也二十块。
src_py: zhè ge èr shí kuài nà ge yě èr shí kuài
task: Say they cost the same, using 跟 ... 一样.
zh: 这个跟那个一样贵。
py: zhè ge gēn nà ge yī yàng guì
en: This one is as expensive as that one.
why: Equal prices are 跟 B 一样 + adjective, with a bare adjective and no 比.

src: 我的球衣跟你的一样。
src_py: wǒ de qiú yī gēn nǐ de yī yàng
task: Make it negative.
zh: 我的球衣跟你的不一样。
py: wǒ de qiú yī gēn nǐ de bù yī yàng
en: My jersey is different from yours.
why: The negative is 不一样, with 不 right in front of 一样.

src: 这本书四十块，那本书七十块。
src_py: zhè běn shū sì shí kuài nà běn shū qī shí kuài
task: Say that one is thirty yuan more expensive, using 比.
zh: 那本书比这本书贵三十块。
py: nà běn shū bǐ zhè běn shū guì sān shí kuài
en: That book is thirty yuan more expensive than this one.
why: The exact amount goes after the adjective: 贵三十块.

src: 这个球拍比那个贵很多。
src_py: zhè ge qiú pāi bǐ nà ge guì hěn duō
task: Say 'much more expensive' with 得多.
zh: 这个球拍比那个贵得多。
py: zhè ge qiú pāi bǐ nà ge guì de duō
en: This racket is much more expensive than that one.
why: 得多 attaches directly to the adjective after the 比 phrase.

src: 他比我高。
src_py: tā bǐ wǒ gāo
task: Deny it with 不比: he is no taller than me.
zh: 他不比我高。
py: tā bù bǐ wǒ gāo
en: He's no taller than I am.
why: 不 goes before 比, giving 不比; the adjective is not negated.

src: 这家店的价格没有那家便宜。
src_py: zhè jiā diàn de jià gé méi yǒu nà jiā pián yi
task: Say the same thing with 不如.
zh: 这家店的价格不如那家便宜。
py: zhè jiā diàn de jià gé bù rú nà jiā pián yi
en: The prices in this shop are not as cheap as in that one.
why: 不如 replaces 没有 and takes the good adjective 便宜 after B.

src: 在所有的水果里，我特别喜欢苹果。
src_py: zài suǒ yǒu de shuǐ guǒ lǐ wǒ tè bié xǐ huan píng guǒ
task: Say I like apples best, using 最.
zh: 我最喜欢苹果。
py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan píng guǒ
en: I like apples best.
why: 最 goes right before 喜欢.

src: 这个商场的人很多。
src_py: zhè ge shāng chǎng de rén hěn duō
task: Say there are fairly many people, using 比较.
zh: 这个商场的人比较多。
py: zhè ge shāng chǎng de rén bǐ jiào duō
en: There are fairly many people in this shopping mall.
why: 比较 replaces 很 in the same slot before the adjective and does not need a B.

src: 她比我游得快。
src_py: tā bǐ wǒ yóu de kuài
task: Move 比我 so that it comes after 得.
zh: 她游得比我快。
py: tā yóu de bǐ wǒ kuài
en: She swims faster than I do.
why: Both positions of 比我 are correct and mean the same; 得 stays with the verb.

src: 我踢足球踢得不好，哥哥踢得很好。
src_py: wǒ tī zú qiú tī de bù hǎo gē ge tī de hěn hǎo
task: Say my older brother plays better than I do, using 比.
zh: 哥哥踢足球踢得比我好。
py: gē ge tī zú qiú tī de bǐ wǒ hǎo
en: My older brother plays football better than I do.
why: With an object the verb repeats before 得, and 比我 can sit before the first verb, before the second verb or after 得.

src: 我跑得比他快。
src_py: wǒ pǎo de bǐ tā kuài
task: Say he does not run as fast as I do, using 没有.
zh: 他跑得没有我快。
py: tā pǎo de méi yǒu wǒ kuài
en: He doesn't run as fast as I do.
why: 没有 + B takes the slot of 比 + B; 得 stays and the adjective stays bare.

src: 城市里的人一年比一年多。
src_py: chéng shì lǐ de rén yī nián bǐ yī nián duō
task: Say it with 越来越.
zh: 城市里的人越来越多了。
py: chéng shì lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
en: There are more and more people in the city.
why: 越来越 goes right before 多, with 了 at the end.

src: 他打篮球打得很好。
src_py: tā dǎ lán qiú dǎ de hěn hǎo
task: Say he plays better and better, with 越来越.
zh: 他打篮球打得越来越好了。
py: tā dǎ lán qiú dǎ de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
en: He plays basketball better and better.
why: 越来越 replaces 很 and follows 得 directly before the adjective.

src: 我喜欢这个运动。
src_py: wǒ xǐ huan zhè ge yùn dòng
task: Say I like it more and more, with 越来越.
zh: 我越来越喜欢这个运动了。
py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan zhè ge yùn dòng le
en: I like this sport more and more.
why: 越来越 goes before the verb of feeling 喜欢, with 了 at the end.

src: 这家超市的水果很新鲜，那家超市的水果更新鲜。
src_py: zhè jiā chāo shì de shuǐ guǒ hěn xīn xiān nà jiā chāo shì de shuǐ guǒ gèng xīn xiān
task: Combine into one sentence with 比 and 更.
zh: 那家超市的水果比这家的更新鲜。
py: nà jiā chāo shì de shuǐ guǒ bǐ zhè jiā de gèng xīn xiān
en: The fruit at that supermarket is even fresher than this one's.
why: The repeated noun after 比 is dropped (这家的), and 更 stays before 新鲜 while 很 disappears.

src: 小王一米八，我一米七五。
src_py: xiǎo wáng yī mǐ bā wǒ yī mǐ qī wǔ
task: Say Xiao Wang is five centimetres taller, using 比.
zh: 小王比我高五厘米。
py: xiǎo wáng bǐ wǒ gāo wǔ lí mǐ
en: Xiao Wang is five centimetres taller than me.
why: The exact difference goes after the adjective: 高五厘米.

s: 这双球鞋比那双很贵。
s_py: zhè shuāng qiú xié bǐ nà shuāng hěn guì
zh: 这双球鞋比那双贵。
py: zhè shuāng qiú xié bǐ nà shuāng guì
en: These sneakers are more expensive than those.
why: 很 cannot stand before the adjective in a 比 sentence. The adjective stays bare, or 更 or 还 is used for 'even'.

s: 这个牌子的衣服比那个牌子的还贵。
zh: 这个牌子的衣服比那个牌子的还贵。
py: zhè ge pái zi de yī fu bǐ nà ge pái zi de hái guì
en: Clothes of this brand are even more expensive than that brand's.
why: 还 is one of the two adverbs allowed before the adjective in a 比 sentence, meaning 'even'. Only 很, 非常 and 太 are ruled out.

s: 他的篮球比我的非常新。
s_py: tā de lán qiú bǐ wǒ de fēi cháng xīn
zh: 他的篮球比我的新。
py: tā de lán qiú bǐ wǒ de xīn
en: His basketball is newer than mine.
why: 非常 is a degree word and cannot sit before the adjective after 比. Keep the adjective bare.

s: 这件比那件有点儿便宜。
s_py: zhè jiàn bǐ nà jiàn yǒu diǎn r pián yi
zh: 这件比那件便宜一点儿。
py: zhè jiàn bǐ nà jiàn pián yi yī diǎn r
en: This one is a little cheaper than that one.
why: 有点儿 goes before an adjective and does not fit a 比 sentence. The amount of difference is 一点儿, after the adjective.

s: 今年的票比去年的贵得多。
zh: 今年的票比去年的贵得多。
py: jīn nián de piào bǐ qù nián de guì de duō
en: This year's tickets are much more expensive than last year's.
why: 得多 after the adjective is the right way to say 'much more' in a 比 sentence; it replaces the impossible 很 before the adjective.

s: 我比弟弟三岁大。
s_py: wǒ bǐ dì di sān suì dà
zh: 我比弟弟大三岁。
py: wǒ bǐ dì di dà sān suì
en: I'm three years older than my younger brother.
why: The number of years goes after the adjective: 大三岁. 三岁大 follows English word order and is not Chinese.

s: 这个比那个便宜一点儿，可是质量好多了。
zh: 这个比那个便宜一点儿，可是质量好多了。
py: zhè ge bǐ nà ge pián yi yī diǎn r kě shì zhì liàng hǎo duō le
en: This one is a bit cheaper than that one, but the quality is much better.
why: Both amount words follow the adjective: 一点儿 for a little, 多了 for a lot. The sentence is correct.

s: 我比他不高。
zh: 我没有他高。
py: wǒ méi yǒu tā gāo
en: I'm not as tall as he is.
why: A 比 sentence is not negated at the adjective. 'Not as tall as' is A 没有 B 高.

s: 这家的衣服没有那家的那么好看。
zh: 这家的衣服没有那家的那么好看。
py: zhè jiā de yī fu méi yǒu nà jiā de nà me hǎo kàn
en: Clothes at this shop are not as nice as at that one.
why: 没有 + B + 那么 + adjective is the standard pattern for 'not as ... as'. The sentence is correct.

s: 今天没有昨天热得多。
s_py: jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān rè de duō
zh: 今天没有昨天那么热。
py: jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me rè
en: Today is not as hot as yesterday.
why: After 没有 the adjective takes no amount or 得多 complement; 那么 may stand before it.

s: 你说他的球技很好，可我觉得他不比我好。
zh: 你说他的球技很好，可我觉得他不比我好。
py: nǐ shuō tā de qiú jì hěn hǎo kě wǒ jué de tā bù bǐ wǒ hǎo
en: You say his skill is great, but I think he's no better than I am.
why: 不比 is the natural way to disagree: 'no better than me'. 不 goes before 比, not before the adjective.

s: 这个手机比不如那个好用。
s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī bǐ bù rú nà ge hǎo yòng
zh: 这个手机不如那个好用。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī bù rú nà ge hǎo yòng
en: This phone is not as easy to use as that one.
why: 不如 replaces 比; the two cannot be stacked. 'A not as good as B' is A 不如 B + adjective.

s: 他的球拍比我的一样新。
s_py: tā de qiú pāi bǐ wǒ de yī yàng xīn
zh: 他的球拍跟我的一样新。
py: tā de qiú pāi gēn wǒ de yī yàng xīn
en: His racket is as new as mine.
why: 比 always marks a difference. Sameness takes 跟 or 和 with 一样.

s: 我的球拍跟你的一样很贵。
s_py: wǒ de qiú pāi gēn nǐ de yī yàng hěn guì
zh: 我的球拍跟你的一样贵。
py: wǒ de qiú pāi gēn nǐ de yī yàng guì
en: My racket is as expensive as yours.
why: After 一样 the adjective stays bare: 很 cannot be added.

s: 现在跑步的人越来越多了。
zh: 现在跑步的人越来越多了。
py: xiàn zài pǎo bù de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
en: More and more people run these days.
why: 越来越 goes right before the adjective 多, with 了 at the end. The sentence is correct.

s: 他是最高在我们队。
s_py: tā shì zuì gāo zài wǒ men duì
zh: 他是我们队最高的。
py: tā shì wǒ men duì zuì gāo de
en: He is the tallest on our team.
why: The group goes before 最: 我们队最高的. English 'tallest in our team' puts it after.

s: 这家商店的东西比较那家便宜。
s_py: zhè jiā shāng diàn de dōng xi bǐ jiào nà jiā pián yi
zh: 这家商店的东西比那家便宜。
py: zhè jiā shāng diàn de dōng xi bǐ nà jiā pián yi
en: Things in this shop are cheaper than in that one.
why: 比较 means 'fairly' and takes no B. 'Than' is 比 alone.

s: 他比我游快。
zh: 他比我游得快。
py: tā bǐ wǒ yóu de kuài
en: He swims faster than I do.
why: The manner of an action needs 得 between verb and adjective, also in a comparison.

s: 妹妹爬山爬得比我快。
zh: 妹妹爬山爬得比我快。
py: mèi mei pá shān pá de bǐ wǒ kuài
en: My younger sister climbs hills faster than I do.
why: With an object the verb repeats, and 比我 may stand right after 得. The sentence is correct.

s: 网上购物越来越很方便了。
s_py: wǎng shàng gòu wù yuè lái yuè hěn fāng biàn le
zh: 网上购物越来越方便了。
py: wǎng shàng gòu wù yuè lái yuè fāng biàn le
en: Online shopping is getting more and more convenient.
why: 越来越 already gives the degree, so 很 cannot be added before the adjective.
